explication: BattleShip is a cross-platform PC and Android port of Super Smash Bros. for N64. A player supplies a supported regional ROM; the Android launcher additionally guides first-run extraction and texture-pack import before starting the game. During play, the port entry point initializes the decompiled game and exposes enhancements, rendering options, hi-res textures, and desktop mod support. The README documents these capabilities, but the supplied excerpts do not show every runtime integration, so some branches have no asserted call edges.
